value: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was used for characterization
Study compared Yanomami from Brazil (n=15) with Yanomami from Venezuela (n=8), Matses (n=24), Tunapuco (n=12), and US urban group (n=44)
Fecal samples were collected from study participants
Taxonomic classification performed using Kraken with NCBI whole genome database
Functional classification performed using SUPER-FOCUS based on SEED database
Study focused on gut microbiome biomarkers and functional diversity
Protocol approved by Oswaldo Cruz Foundation Ethics Committee No. 638/11 and CONEP No. 16907
